_comment: This repo's `./dev.sh check`, in parts, run by devtools/parts.py (its header is the format; a rendered copy of tools/checks/checkslib/parts.py). A part per tests/test_*.py, then each gate dev.sh documents, run as `./dev.sh <gate>`. A part that reads what no files list can name (another repo, the workspace, a file mode other than the executable bit) says `always` and is never skipped by --resume. A gate exiting 3 (UNCHECKED) is a failed part here: the runner has no unchecked outcome. tests/test_parts.py holds this file to the test modules and to dev.sh's gates.

parts.name: test.parts
parts.always: compares devtools/parts.py with tools/checks' runner source and runs the shared checks CLI, outside this repo

parts.name: hooktests
parts.always: two hook tests (test-prefer-recipes, test-troubleshooting) read site-scrapers beside this repo

parts.name: hubtests
parts.always: the classifier's parity test runs tools/hooks' shared write-target parser, and the no-names audit reads the workspace's folder names, outside this repo

parts.name: sealed
parts.always: reads each copy's mode (0444), which no part hash counts beyond the executable bit

parts.name: plans
parts.always: runs tools/setup's plans parser, outside this repo

parts.name: checks
parts.always: `checks run .` reads tools/checks, tools/hooks, the workspace top and the user's settings
